title: Shanghai
sideASummary: Infection deck back. Red biohazard on black, with a yellow caution stripe. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Shanghai Infection card, red. The name runs down the left edge. A blank white panel in the middle takes one improvement sticker. A green plague ring sits on a faded map. No search box and no coordinates. Printed code P3-15b.

rules: Red Infection card for Shanghai. One copy.
The white panel is the one improvement slot. Rebirth, from this package, is the sticker that fits a slot like this.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
notes: Printed code P3-15b is on side B only. Side A is the Infection deck back.
The city's coordinates and port marking are on its Player card, not on this Infection card.
